newsitem.title: UK: Sedgwick chairman to retire next April.
newsitem.headline: Sedgwick chairman to retire next April.

text.p: Insurance firm Sedgwick Group Plc said on Thursday its chairman Lord Fanshawe would step down at its annual meeting on April 24 next year, but remain on the board as a non-executive director.
Sedgwick chief executive Saxon Riley will succeed him as chairman and vice-chairman Rob White-Cooper will become chief executive.
Riley will focus on group strategy and help with investor relations.
Quill Healey, chairman of Sedgwick's North American retail operations and Richard Titley, chairman of Sedgwick Europe Risk Services Ltd, will become vice-chairmen from the date of the annual meeting.
